- **Bread roll:** it measures roughly 250 px by 150 px, or about 12 × 7 cm, and looks like a half roll about 4 cm tall. I estimated 65 g.
- **Lasagna or baked pasta with sauce:** it covers about 250 × 230 px, or about 11 × 10 cm, at about 3 cm thick. That is roughly 330 cm³ at about 1 g/cm³, but part of the footprint is thin, so I estimated 230 g. The sauce and cheese on top are included in that figure.
- **Roast chicken:** it looks like a half chicken or a quarter with the bone in, about 14 × 12 cm. I estimated about 170 g total, of which roughly 110 g is edible.
- **Sliced steak:** there are two thin strips, each about 6 cm long, so I estimated 25 g.
